title: nftDAO
description:
NFT maker upload their NFT through NFTDAO's frontend. nftDAO token holders will be able to vote for their desired NFT. NFTs with the highest votes will be able to be minted and listed on nftDAO marketplace. Built with Zora Protcol.
nftDAO voters are able to receive shares of sales through Zora's BidShares.
how_its_made:
NFTDAO's frontend with Pinata's IPFS backend service. Zora's Minting and auction functionailty. Zora's Smart contract is amazing. The next uniswap. nftDAO is made by mainly - Javascript and Solidity. 

HTTPS and yadahyadah. Also, Web3 ,Solidity, React ,Pinata and last but not least , IPFS.
